About Brainbase

Brainbase is building the primitives for the next 1B agents.

We power internal agents across government, Fortune 500, frontier labs and hyper-growth startups. Enterprises use our configurable primitives such as evals, observability, router, authentication, permissions, sandboxes, harnesses and more to deploy internal agents securely at scale. We support 8+ harness and 50+ models, including sovereign deployments.

 

About Brainbase Embed

Brainbase Embed is a multi-month outcome-oriented deployment program where we engage with high-value customers by embedding engineers internally to manage their Brainbase deployment from start to finish.

About the role

You would be primarily responsible for 1-or-more accounts at a time and see their process from post-sales to deployment and beyond.

This role covers our EMEA customers and is fully remote — you can be based anywhere in Europe, the Middle East or Africa, with occasional travel to customer sites.

We're a stealth holding company acquiring and operating software businesses in overlooked, mission-critical industries - the systems that run the physical economy but have been ignored by Silicon Valley. We're rebuilding them as AI-native from the inside out.

We're small, well-capitalized, and moving fast. This is not a research lab. This is a build shop with real customers, real revenue, and real P&Ls.



The Role

You will be the AI engineer. You'll own:

 1. Building the industry-specific GPT: the reasoning layer that encodes the domain expertise of each vertical we operate in.

 2. Embedding AI-native functionality directly into our AI-native system of record: not bolt-on chatbots. Core workflow replacement. Agents that do the job.

 3. Moving legacy systems of record datasets into new ai-native ones: Core workflow replacement. Agents that do the job.

 4. Making it repeatable: Every new company we bring into the portfolio should benefit from the playbook, model stack, eval harness, and infra you build.

 5. Managing AI talent across our operating companies: you'll be a player-coach for the AI engineers embedded at each sub.



Split: 90% building. 10% managing. If that ratio scares you, this isn't your role. If it excites you, keep reading.



What You'll Do…

 - Ship a working domain-specific agent into a live customer environment in your first 30 days

 - Build the eval infrastructure that lets us measure whether these agents are actually replacing human workflows (not vibes)

 - Fine-tune, distill, or route across frontier + open models depending on the economics of each vertical

 - Sit with customers. Watch them work. Instrument their workflows. Rebuild them.

 - Write the AI engineering playbook that every future portfolio company inherits on day one



Who You Are…

 - You are a builder first. You've shipped things people actually use. Alone or as the clear technical lead.

 - You are a forward-deployed engineer. You'll fly to a customer site, sit in their office, and understand the business before you write a line of code.

 - You've been called a 10x engineer and it wasn't in a self-review.

 - You have demonstrated experience building and deploying production-grade AI/LLM harnesses that connect models to customer data, tools, APIs, and business workflows, with appropriate evaluation, observability, guardrails, and failure handling.

 - You have strong opinions about when to fine-tune vs. prompt vs. RAG vs. agent vs harness and you can defend them with numbers.

 - You've built with the current frontier stack (Claude, GPT, Gemini, open models) in production, not just in a Jupyter notebook.

 - You are allergic to slide decks and comfortable with ambiguity, small teams, and unglamorous industries.



What This Role Is Not…

 - A research role. We ship.

 - A management role. You build.

 - A "Head of AI" title for LinkedIn. You will be in the codebase daily.

 - A place for people who need process, roadmaps handed to them, or a 20-person team to feel productive.

We are focused on building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you’re excited about this role, but do not meet 100% of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply.
